context.hint: Review parser boundaries for a filter that removes disallowed active content while preserving permitted markup.
context.surface: A standalone HTML filter handles element boundaries, comments, quoted attributes, and URL-valued fields in static documents.
assumptions: The filter contract defines which elements and attributes are allowed and how permitted content is preserved.
The source evidence covers focused local fixtures. Integrated and browser-level verification remain open.

review.invariant: Attribute policy acts on parsed attribute names and normalized values. Allowed attributes and surrounding text retain their documented representation.
review.verification: Check allowed and denied fixture attributes in a single document. Verify that quoted values containing punctuation remain intact and that validation receives normalized values before policy decisions.

source_observation.summary: Nine local attribute fixtures passed after correcting handling of quoted values. The draft deliberately rejected some ambiguous values conservatively. Browser behavior, broader markup contexts and integrated verification remained open.
